programme.title: Helping Hands Garage - Stored Camaro
programme.desc: After years of sitting in storage, the Wilburn family is determined to get their beloved 81’ Camaro back on the road. Katie and Collete along with the Helping Hands provide a little help and a lot of determination to help this Military family bring the Camaro back to life.

programme.title: Helping Hands Garage - Next Generation
programme.desc: When the Haddox family inherited a Chevelle they wanted to convert it from an old race car to a weekend driver. They don’t know where to start and their daughters want to learn how to work on the car, so they bring it into the Helping Hands Garage and we’ll see if the next generation can catch the car bug.

programme.title: Helping Hands Garage - Courageous Jeep
programme.desc: The Heinze family's courageous young daughter has been in and out of hospitals fighting a rare condition since she was born. There is no time for the family to work on their cherished Jeep or take any off-road trips. With the support of the Helping Hands team, their ride is revamped into something that brings them joy and adventure.

programme.title: Helping Hands Garage - Firefighter Mustang Surprise
programme.desc: A Mom wants to fix her firefighter son's dream Mustang before his upcoming wedding. The car has been dormant for years and Katie and Collete will put together the best Helping Hands team to give this Mustang the first-rate attention this brave son, and soon-to-be husband, deserves.

programme.title: Helping Hands Garage - “Penelope” Cruise
programme.desc: This '73 Dodge Charger was pushed aside when the Barron family’s oldest daughter passed away. Now the family is ready to charge ahead and get the car running again in Kaitlyn’s honor.

programme.title: Helping Hands Garage - Pay It Forward
programme.desc: Katie, Collete and the Helping Hands team up with non-profit organization “Wheels of Success” to restore an Acura to provide to a hardworking single mom. The Helping Hands team will make sure "Gray Bay Bay" can stay on the road for another 100k miles.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Diamond in Dodge City
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Don't Tell Dale
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Biker Lore
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Vegas Payday
programme.desc: Big Time Motorcycle Auction

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Second Time's a Charm
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Wounded Warrior Project
programme.desc: Home Depot Senior Vice President, Gordon Erickson, is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hardware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Orphan Bikes
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concours have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, that aren't a Harley nor Indian machines.

programme.title: What's In the Barn? - Time is Not On Their Side
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - Detailing a Motorcoach
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how to detail various aspects of a motorcoach, including wheels and tires, granite care, proper leather care, as well as glass cleaning.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage - How To Wash Car
programme.desc: Nick Rutter showcases the products and process to properly wash your vehicle, from start to finish, starting with the wheels and tires and finishing with cleaning door jambs.

programme.title: Truck U - Construction Work Truck
programme.desc: You’ve Seen Matt and Bruno’s skills in the garage; now check out their skills on the job site. We’ll take one worker’s truck and make the repairs by quitting time.

programme.title: Truck U - Time for Toys
programme.desc: Time to get the toys out of the garage. The weather has changed, and we want to make sure our RV, boat, and UTV are ready to roll.

programme.title: Truck U - Blazer TLC
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno go to work on a 1986 Blazer that needs some TLC.

programme.title: Truck U - Misdiagnosis
programme.desc: Any shop can misdiagnose a problem. All that means is more trips back to the shop for you. Today Bruno and Matt take a look at some of the most commonly misdiagnosed problems and help you fix them for good.

programme.title: Truck U - Tundra Look-Alike
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno bring in a pair of Toyota Tundra’s. The only problem, what truck gets what parts? Let the competition begin.

programme.title: Truck U - Ford EcoBoost
programme.desc: Its our first look at the Ford EcoBoost V6 engine, and we don’t leave anything stock. We’ll keep the more efficient engine and add some power today on Truck U.

programme.title: Truck U - Federated Work Truck
programme.desc: Why build a regular work truck, when you can build the Ultimate Work Truck. Our challenge today is to take a stock 2013 Silverado and outfit it from head to toe, and when we’re done, we’re giving it away.

programme.title: Truck U - TruckUbicon
programme.desc: We start with a 2012 stock Jeep JK and build it up to get ready to go off-road only at the massive Jeep Beach Event at Daytona International speedway.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - SMOKEY
programme.desc: In the 1960s, Smokey Yunick, the most innovative mechanic in NASCAR history, sold his famous truck that hauled equipment & cars across the country. Ray is on a mission to uncover this storied truck that helped launch the beginning of NASCAR’s cross-country popularity.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - VANDERBILT
programme.desc: Ray travels to Long Island, New York with the hopes of learning more about America’s first major auto racing competition. The race, which began at the turn of the 20th century, helped develop the first major American racing stars and drove American manufacturing to competitive standard with the highly progressive Europeans.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - RAYS ROOTS
programme.desc: Fred Dmuchowski is a New Jersey racing icon. He was a regular workingman who raced on weekends for fun and became a legend in his iconic 303 racer. Ray works to rebuild the 303 in homage to Fred who inspired him to pursue his career in motorsports.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - THE CORVETTE
programme.desc: For Rick Hendrick, the Corvette inspired his first car purchase, which ultimately led to the creation of his car dealership empire and motorsports teams. Mr. H, as he goes by, gives us a rare look inside of his personal Corvette collection and takes us to General Motors World Headquarters to talk with GM Vice President of Global Design, Ed Welburn, about how this iconic car came about. Country superstar Brad Paisley makes a cameo appearance to talk about his prized ‘Vette and the influence of cars on his music.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - ELVIS VAULT
programme.desc: The last car Elvis drove the evening he passed was his beloved Stutz Blackhawk. Ray discovers that the car has been preserved and heads to Graceland to check out this iconic piece of American music history. Ray and the team reveal the impeccable preservation of the car at Charlotte Motor Speedway with Rick Hendrick (“Mr. H”) and, arguably Elvis Presley’s biggest fan, Dale Earnhardt Jr. While at Graceland, Ray and the team also get an exclusive look at the paneled station wagon Elvis used to get in and out of Graceland in disguise. It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.title: AmeriCarna - BAND OF BROTHERS
programme.desc: This episode takes an inside look at the famous racing L88 Corvette. From its history, to its successes and heartbreaks, to the stories of the men that drove it. Now, it’s a car world’s version of the Flinstones meet the Jetsons, as the Owens Corning Corvette, which clinched 22 straight race victories, challenges the new Corvette C7-R at Sebring International Raceway. The original Owens Corning team reunites for the challenge and our crew goes behind the scenes for the Corvette test drive of a lifetime.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Kenny Rogers' Family Values
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is back at the beach on Jekyll Island with a focus on cars and families. Fathers & sons, with their barn-find Pilot House trucks and Plymouth Satellites, call cars the glue that keeps them bonded together with C&O being the best place to show them off.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - SEMA: Inside Fuller's Head
programme.desc: On this edition of Caffeine & Octane, we’ll go inside the head of Master Builder Bryan Fuller at the SEMA car show, the largest annual trade show in the country; SEMA always brings out the best in the automotive industry. From a jaw dropping Javelin to a multimillion-dollar Pagani, Brian will prove to you, what happens in Vegas, doesn’t always stay in Vegas! Ryan Hardwick guest hosts and ventures deep into the C&O lots to find his favorite ride of the day.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Motor Masters
programme.desc: Take apart and assemble a motor in less than 30 minutes? Sure, NASCAR pit crews can make the claim, but can a rag tag group of kids with names like Jelly Donut, Butter Bean, and Wonder Woman claim the pit fame? Host Rickey Gadson heads to the Sims Academy to settle a bet. This ultra fast half-hour edition of Caffeine & Octane also includes a builder’s take on an Ultra Four Unlimited Off-Road Racer; Ryan Hardwick joins the gang at Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Viva Cuba!
programme.desc: Demetrio Montalvo likes American music, American food, and especially American cars. Only one problem - Demetrio lives in Cuba. A Visa, bestowed to him from some American friends in high places, lets him travel to the States to search for tough to find automotive parts and attend his favorite car show. Showing up to Caffeine & Octane in a cool caddy is the easy part. Picking parts to take back home presents a unique set of challenges for the Cuban car builder; Formula Drift racer Federico Sceriffo brings the first ever Formula Drift Ferrari to C&O.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Magnus Walker's Secret Porsche Collection
programme.desc: Porsche collector, customizer, and Urban Outlaw, Magnus Walker is a world-wide rock star to fans of the German car company. So, when Caffeine & Octane producers invited him to travel cross country to tell the story of a hidden Porsche collection tangled in a North Georgia Vineyard, they were surprised when he signed on. No sour grapes here, what Walker found at the Wolf Mountain Winery will impress even those with the most refined palette for Porsches.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Chipper Jones' International Car Show
programme.desc: A Hall of Famer?s search for an Exotic Car that fits; a blind man?s ?touchy feely? approach to seeing great cars.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane - Fuller's "2029" Majestic Build
programme.desc: Back to the future with a Majestic build from Fuller Moto that showcases 3-D printed parts, an electric motor, and hub-centric steering.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: The new Porsche Boxter, a real open-top sports car. Also: Volkswagen presents the new Passat Alltrack, a real allrounder. And: Fiat's successful Panda model in its third generation version.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: The Mercedes Sprinter belongs to the class of commercial vehicles. The light transporter is the dream for every tradesman. The third generation Sprinter is sleeker, more modern and more variable than ever.

programme.title: Arden AJ23
programme.desc: A Jaguar that is able to terrify the world alone with its roar. This Jaguar F-Type R tuned by Arden is a real bad boy. Already in the series production configuration, the F-Type R Coupe is a dream car that can really bite but this Jaguar which has been upgraded from Arden, now calls itself "AJ23“ and is more powerful, louder and more aggressive than any of his brothers.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The sound of the McLaren 720S Spider is that of an uncompromising driving machine. Also: the F-Pace SVR makes a rather sophisticated impression. And: is the Porsche Cayenne coupe's higher price justifiable compared to the regular model?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: How much power is there in the Limited Edition of the Seat Cupra Ateca? Also: are the Porsche 718 Boxster and the Cayman in the GTS version an alternative to the expensive 911? And: the exclusive preview of Audi's RS6 powerful station wagon.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Does the Skoda Enyaq Coupe RS iV live up to the famous "Rally Sport" abbreviation in its model designation as an e-car? And how does Mercedes-AMG manage without the brand's usual V8 sound in the EQE 53?

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Two car brands turn their drive concepts upside down: for the first time since the 1980s, Maserati builds a mid-engine sports car. And Corvette's C8 with mid-engine instead of classic front-wheel drive redefines the American Dream.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: We focus on premium-quality electric cars. The Mercedes EQS 450+ faces our test in the Swiss Alps. Plus: Is the Porsche Taycan Cross Turismo Turbo S the ultimate mobility all-purpose weapon? And: The Audi E-Tron GT from the same platform as the Taycan.

programme.title: Alpina B6
programme.desc: An Alpina is optically never intrusive. Understatement is the motto. One should not recognize at first glance, what potential is hidden under the bodywork. Huge spoilers are not used and neither are striking power domes. Any modifications serve the technical improvement, for example, optimized cooling and aerodynamics.

programme.title: Ford GT40
programme.desc: With their V8 cars, Ford showed that they were able to build race winners. The Ford GT40 was a prime example for that, especially in Le Mans.

programme.title: Ignition GT
programme.desc: Juliet gets behind the wheel of the eagerly awaited Lexus RZ. Lepas kicks off their local product onslaught with the L4 and Zee gets acquainted with Omoda’s new mid-range C7.

programme.title: Buyer's Guide
programme.desc: We assess a Nissan Qashqai to decide if repairs are worth it, revisit a high-mileage Fortuner for long-term ownership, and compare reliable 7-seater options.

programme.title: IGNITION Goes to SEMA
programme.desc: Get ready for more SEMA madness coming your way! From a modified bakkie to a Corvette sporting some DNA from both Pagani and Koenigsegg.

programme.title: Petrolheads
programme.desc: We check out some rides at project X at the meet and greet in Soshanguve. We chat to two of the youngest competitors at the Sasol Solar challenge. And we profile a gorgeous Audi A3.

programme.title: Bugatti Chiron
programme.desc: The successor to the Bugatti Veyron - the Chiron - is a mid-engined two-seated sports car developed and manufactured in Molsheim, France, by Bugatti Automobiles S.A.S. The car was based on the Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo concept car and is named after the Monegasque driver Louis Chiron.

programme.title: Dreamcars
programme.desc: German convertibles like the the Porsche 911 Cabriolet or the Mercedes-AMG Roadster enjoy a worldwide reputation. They stand for perfection and reliability and are considered the embodiment of status and an expression of lifestyle and joy of life.

programme.title: NPL - NPL 2024 – Women’s Doubles Championship – Carter & Ojeda vs Zelenski & Kordic Mueller
programme.desc: The stakes are sky-high in this 2024 National Pickleball League Women’s Doubles Championship as the Coachella Valley Scorpions' dynamic duo, Molly Carter and Kelly Ojeda, take on the formidable Denver Iconics pairing of Stacy Zelenski and Lily Kordic Mueller. Filmed at a championship stop on the NPL tour, this intense match features fierce net battles, pinpoint placement, and relentless energy on both sides of the court. Watch as Carter & Ojeda push the pace and mount a relentless offensive, while Zelenski & Kordic Mueller counter with sharp angles and strategic resets. A hard-fought final that captures the spirit, skill, and teamwork of professional women’s pickleball.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) - WPBL 2025 - Hyderabad vs. Bengaluru - Day 2 Tie 1
programme.desc: Day 2 of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) kicks off with an exciting matchup between the Hyderabad Superstars and the Bengaluru team. This matchup begins with a highly anticipated Men's Singles match: Hyderabad's local talent, Kuldeep Mahajan, faces Bengaluru's Jack Foster from the United States.

programme.title: NPL - NPL 2024 – Mixed Team Match – Drivers vs Ignite
programme.desc: The National Pickleball League heats up as the Indianapolis Drivers take on the Austin Ignite in a coed team match packed with intensity, teamwork, and standout rallies. Representing two competitive NPL franchises, this mixed showdown brings high-level play, strategic depth, and crowd-fueled energy to the court. Whether you're cheering for the Drivers or backing the Ignite, this match is a showcase of what makes NPL team pickleball exciting to watch.

programme.title: Picklebowl 2023 - Picklebowl 2023 – Mixed Doubles Final – Yates & Wuerffel vs Bright & Hafez
programme.desc: In the exciting championship match of Picklebowl 2023, pro pickleball player Kyle Yates teams up with Picklebowl host and former NFL quarterback Danny Wuerffel to challenge the fierce duo of Anna Bright, a top female pro and former collegiate tennis star, and Ameen Hafez. This charity event brings together athletes and celebrities representing their alma maters in a competitive battle for the Picklebowl trophy. Commentary by Dave Fleming and special guest Marcellus Wiley highlights the skill, strategy, and drama on court. Watch intense rallies, strategic plays, and hear insider insights as these top players compete for the title. Don’t miss the dynamic energy and social spirit of pickleball in this must-see final.

programme.title: All Florida Pro League - AFPL Stop 4 Championship Court - Game 5 - Sarasota Manatees vs. Lakeland Palms
programme.desc: This episode of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida, features a redemption match between the Sarasota Manatees and the Lakeland Palms. Both teams are coming off a loss and are looking for a win in this intense doubles matchup. The Manatees jump out to an early lead, but the Palms, with strong play from players like Ava and Ashley Griffith, manage to crawl back into the game and make it a nail-biting finish. The episode features courtside commentary from Jay Carroll and Hugh Greene.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2022 - US Open 2022 – Men’s Pro Doubles Final – Johns & Johns vs Wright & Newman
programme.desc: Championship Court hosts a star-studded final as brothers Ben and Collin Johns take on Matt Wright and Riley Newman in this Men’s Pro Doubles finale. Packed with elite strategy, blistering hand battles, and dramatic swings, this is top-tier pickleball at its most intense.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 - US Open 2025 - Pro Women's Doubles - Waters/Waters vs. Fuzesi/Maalouf
programme.desc: Watch as the formidable mother-daughter duo, Lee and Anna Leigh Waters, take on challengers from North Carolina in this Pro Women's Doubles match from the US National Pickleball Center. After an injury, it is great to see the champions partner up again, demonstrating the "fire and ice" style of play that has made them national champions. While the Waters team's game one was a quick 11-point victory, the challengers, Fuzesi and Maloof, handled themselves well on the championship court. The players at home can learn from Anna Leigh's "instigator" shots and two-handed backhand rolls, which she helped bring to the big stage.

The action features Men's Singles between American Champion Brandon Lane (Mumbai) and Polish #1 Mathias Matysik (Pune), followed by Women's Doubles (Katie Morris & Glauca Lane) and Men's Doubles where Vansh Kapadia and his partner secure Pune's first match win. Experience high-stakes professional pickleball where every point counts for the WPBL semi-finals.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025 - US Open 2025 - Mixed Pro Doubles - Agassi/Waters vs. Petrouleas/Dussault
programme.desc: The match features the second-seeded team of Anna Leigh Waters, the world's number one ranked women's player and a Triple Crown winner, and Andre Agassi, an eight-time Grand Slam tennis champion making his pro pickleball debut. They face the young team of Stevie Petruleas (13 years old) and Tristan Dassault (16 years old), who are playing in only their third tournament together and are looking to make their mark against the seasoned pros. The match highlights key plays, including Agassi's powerful two-handed backhand and Waters' quickness at the kitchen line, and showcases the dynamic between these experienced and rising stars in the sport.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship - Senior Women's Doubles Final - Gray/Linton vs. Ramirez/Senciales
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, hosts the Senior Women's Doubles Final under the floodlights . Team England, represented by Kirsty Gray and Anna Linton, faces off against Team Spain's Monica Ramirez and Araceli Senciales .After a strong start where England establishes an early lead, the match tightens as Spain finds their rhythm in the second game . Witness the strategic battle as Gray utilizes precision lobs to disrupt the Spanish defense , while Linton delivers powerful drives to secure critical points . In a high-stakes contest for the gold medal, England targets their opponents' positioning to close out the championship .

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 - US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 - Men's Pro Doubles - Semifinal
programme.desc: Kyle Yates and William Sobek take on James Johnson and Dylan Frazier in this Men's Pro Doubles Semifinal.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) - WPBL 2026 - Rajasthan vs Pune - Day 6 Tie 2
programme.desc: Witness a battle for survival at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai as two powerhouse teams, the Rajasthan Titans and Pune United, fight to secure their first tie victory of the season. The energy is palpable as Pune United's Katie Morris looks for redemption after a tough opening night, while the Titans rely on the aggressive play of Lorena Dupnik and the "superb power" of volleyball-pro-turned-pickleballer Isabella Nelson. From the intense "grind" of 15-minute singles matches to the high-speed tactical exchanges of men’s and women’s doubles, every point is a step toward climbing the league ladder. Don't miss the strategic masterclasses, including high-stakes challenges and game-changing "Pickle Plays," that keep the Mumbai crowd on the edge of their seats.

programme.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball - Tuesday Night Pickleball - January 3 2023 - All Stars Mixed Doubles
programme.desc: January 3, 2023 - Live from The Orchard @ Jigsaw Health, it's Tuesday Night Pickleball

programme.title: Pickleball England - English Nationals 2023 – Women’s Doubles Final – Giuliano & Kao vs Kubrick-Finney & Lock
programme.desc: Catch the final showdown from the 2023 English Nationals as Mollie Kubrick-Finney and Thaddea Lock challenge reigning champs Antonella Giuliano and Pei Chun Kao. Featuring sharp angles, aggressive volleys, and expert analysis, this match crowns the best in British women’s doubles.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) - WPBL 2026 - Pune vs Chennai - Day 11 Tie 1
programme.desc: Witness a high-stakes showdown on the final day of league competition as the undefeated Chennai Super Champs face off against a determined Pune United squad in a battle for postseason momentum. The atmosphere at Mumbai’s Jio World Garden is electric, featuring a "lip-smacking" women's singles battle between European stars Katie Morris and Dominika Turkovic. As Pune fights to stay alive in the tie, coach Rusty Sobeck looks for a breakthrough in a tactical mixed doubles clash against Jonny Goldberg’s top-tier rotation. From "stunning singles fight backs" to a strategic masterclass in doubles positioning, this tie showcases the intense grit required to challenge the league's only unbeaten titan.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship - Men's Singles Open Final - Chaudry vs. Karbownik
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, concludes its first day with the historic Men's Singles Open Final under the floodlights. England's captain James Chaudry, the only active European player with a DUPR rating over 6.0, faces off against Poland's Bartosz Karbownik (referred to as Kabosnik/Kabashnik in audio).Chaudry dominates early with a mix of power and precise cross-court angles, taking the first game decisively. While Karbownik produces moments of brilliance, including a spectacular passing shot, he struggles with his footing on the clay surface. Witness Team England secure the gold medal in the inaugural singles event of the championships.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 - US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 - Women's Senior Pro Doubles - Bronze Medal Match
programme.desc: Molly Carter and Kim Kesner take on Pam Ruoff and Erica Marsh in this Women's Senior Pro Bronze Medal Match.

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2023 - US Open 2023 – Men’s Senior Pro Doubles Quarterfinal – Prodanov & Moore vs Crandall & Derisi
programme.desc: Watch a masterclass in senior pro pickleball as Peter Prodanov and Scott Moore take on Scott Crandall and Jose Derisi. With explosive hands, strategic play, and experience driving every point, this US Open quarterfinal is a showcase of skill, grit, and high-level doubles tactics.

programme.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) - WPBL 2026 - Mumbai vs Bengaluru - Day 5 Tie 1
programme.desc: Experience the electric atmosphere of the World Pickleball League (WPBL) Season 2 as the Mumbai Pickle Power face off against the Bengaluru Jawans in a high-stakes Tie 9. With Mumbai hunting for their first outright victory and Bengaluru desperate to bounce back from a recent loss, the pressure at the Jio World Garden is at an all-time high. Watch as elite players like the "unstoppable" Katrina Stewart dominate the court in singles, while Brandon Lane and Glaura Carvajal Lane attempt to turn the tide for Mumbai in a masterclass of tactical doubles. This tie features the league’s most innovative strategies, from high-risk Pickle Plays to the pursuit of the prestigious Band of Honor, ensuring every rally is a battle for survival on the road to the semi-finals.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship - Women's Senior Singles Final - Linton vs. Tampieri
programme.desc: Witness one of the most exciting finals from the European Pickleball Championships 2025 in Rome. In the Women's Senior Singles Open Final, Team England’s Anna Linton takes on Team Italy’s Paola Tampieri at the iconic Stadio dei Marmi. Linton starts with commanding form, dominating the first game with powerful forehand drives. programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 - US Open 2024 – Men’s Split Pro Doubles Gold Medal Match – Frazier & Merchant vs Daescu & Weinbach
programme.desc: In this thrilling gold medal match from the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships, Dylan Frazier and Altaf Merchant take on defending champions Andrei Daescu and Dave Weinbach in the Men’s Split Pro Doubles division. The action heats up fast as Frazier and Merchant dominate early, only to be met with a fierce comeback from Daescu and Weinbach in game two. Momentum swings, net-cord drama, and tactical shifts lead to an electrifying third game where every point counts.From Frazier’s lightning-fast hands to Daescu’s towering net play, this match showcases elite shot-making, sharp strategy, and high emotion on Championship Court. With the crowd on edge and the gold medal on the line, it’s a true masterclass in professional pickleball.

programme.desc: Witness a high-stakes showdown on the final day of league competition as the undefeated Chennai Super Champs face off against a determined Pune United squad in a battle for postseason momentum. programme.title: European Pickleball Championship - Men's Singles Open Final - Chaudry vs. Karbownik
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, concludes its first day with the historic Men's Singles Open Final under the floodlights. England's captain James Chaudry, the only active European player with a DUPR rating over 6.0, faces off against Poland's Bartosz Karbownik (referred to as Kabosnik/Kabashnik in audio).Chaudry dominates early with a mix of power and precise cross-court angles, taking the first game decisively. While Karbownik produces moments of brilliance, including a spectacular passing shot, he struggles with his footing on the clay surface. Witness Team England secure the gold medal in the inaugural singles event of the championships.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 371 - KOK Best Of Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Best of King of Kings part 2. In a boxing match Naglis Tamasevicius faces Juris Zundovskis. In a clash of the titans, heavyweight Martin Pacas is matched up against Turkey's Kadir Yildirim "The Terminator." Farshad Derekeh of the Netherlands and Latvian Reinis Porozovs take to the ring in a boxing bout and Beka Gabisonia faces Farruh Gafurov in the Mega Series.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 423 - Shamrock FC 360
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 360 from St. Louis. In tonight's episode, Vince Eazelle and John Long, making his pro debut, step into the cage for a kickboxing match and Billy Duncan faces Jamison Hartweger in a Welterweight division bout. In the co-main event UFC veterans Darian Weeks and Donovan Beard faceoff in the cage and in the main event Jake Collier, UFC veteran, and Christian Edwards, Bellator veteran, are set to meet the challenge in the Light Heavyweight division.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 424 - KOK 122 Riga
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK 122 from Riga, Latvia. In the first matchup Piotr Cybulski and Aleksandrs Zeleznakovs head to the ring for what's expected to be an intense kickboxing bout. Also in this episode Savvas Kagkelidis and Ilija Ivanov faceoff and in a Light Heavyweight bout Jan Pelak and Kristaps Zile step into the ring for a bout under boxing rules. In another Light Heavyweight matchup Deniss Jermakovs takes on Kristaps Zutis in a rapper versus fighter in an MMA contest. In the main event Rodrigo Mineiro and Zaurs Dzavadovs battle for the Interim Welterweight Championship belt.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 414 - Shamrock FC 358
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship 358 fromKansas City. Starting off, in the Bantamweight division, Corey Leonard challenges hometown favorite Anthony Dooley. Meanwhile Justin Andrews and Logan Blow head to the cage and Tyler Collings takes on Diego Huerta in the light heavyweight division. Also watch as Mason Pillow and Tyler Smith square off in a Catchweight contest and Glendal Whitney faces Carl Jefferson. In the co-main event, undefeated Tyson Hicks takes on veteran Jamese Taylor. In the main event Eric Grant faces Cjay Hunter in a highly anticipated rematch of striker versus grappler.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 471 - Shamrock FC 370 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 370 part 1 from Ameristar Casino in Missouri. In the first match, Gabe Sestan steps into the cage with Adam Cook followed by Reggie Morris versus Jackson Blankenship. Also on the card Ian Houston takes on Garrenn Lucas in the catchweight division plus Shaine Moffitt versus Kody McGehee in a lightweight bout. In the co-main event, Austin Miller, a kickboxer crosses over to MMA taking on Michael Banks.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 481 - Dream Boxing 14 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dream Boxing 14 part 1 from Riga, Latvia. First up Miks Berzins takes on Aleksandrs Sidorans for a heavyweight bout. The next matchup is betweeen Mika Bigvava from Georgia and Bohdan Sobol from Latvia with 18 wins and only one loss. In the ffinal match, Aleksis Volkovics, making his pro-debut, and Igor Trosins, both Latvian, take to the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 418 - Country Box 29
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Jimmy Adams Promotions, Country Box "Where Music Meets Boxing" from Nashville at the famous Troubadour venue. In this episode of Country Box 29, Raquan Ashby faces Ryan Diaz and Oliver Mcall is back at age 59, with 39 KO's the former WBC heavyweight champion (knocking out Lennox Lewis) takes on Gary Cobia. In the main event, the more experienced Vaughn Alexander tests the undefeated Maidel Sando. Plus singer Krista Dudley plays an original song.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 420 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1 from Oradea, Romania. Starting in the heavyweight division, Remus Bortea is matched up against Vasile Corcodel whose three wins are all by KO. In a Superfight middleweight division bout, Darius Argyo takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga in what's expected to be a fast paced bout. Also in this episode is Brazil versus Romania with two very experienced fighters, Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Claudio "The Prince" Badoi in an open weight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 471 - Shamrock FC 370 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 370 part 1 from Ameristar Casino in Missouri. In the first match, Gabe Sestan steps into the cage with Adam Cook followed by Reggie Morris versus Jackson Blankenship. Also on the card Ian Houston takes on Garrenn Lucas in the catchweight division plus Shaine Moffitt versus Kody McGehee in a lightweight bout. In the co-main event, Austin Miller, a kickboxer crosses over to MMA taking on Michael Banks.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 371 - KOK Best Of Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Best of King of Kings part 2. In a boxing match Naglis Tamasevicius faces Juris Zundovskis. In a clash of the titans, heavyweight Martin Pacas is matched up against Turkey's Kadir Yildirim "The Terminator." Farshad Derekeh of the Netherlands and Latvian Reinis Porozovs take to the ring in a boxing bout and Beka Gabisonia faces Farruh Gafurov in the Mega Series.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 393 - Centurion FC 19 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championships 19 part 1 from Rio de Janeiro. First up Darlan Santos takes on Junior "The Golden Boy" Dias in an intense matchup with contrasting styles. In a dynamic clash, Helio "Big Boy" Nunes, known for his aggressive style and strong finishing abilities, takes on Rafael Silva, who will rely on his stand-up striking skills in a dynamic clash. Expect an intense, high-energy bout between two rising Brazilian fighter as Milson Castro Barao faces William Lima Malvadeza in the first Grand Prix semi-final fight. In the Grand Prix semi-final 2 Walber Dos Anjos Timoteo faces Paulo Henrique Laia in what should be a well-rounded and technical fight followed by the Grand Prix final match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 415 - Red Owl XIII part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XIIi part 1 from The Owl's Nest in Houston. In this episode Bre'yon Gorham (17-0) takes on Alan Ayala (11-4) each with a heafty number of knockouts in this Houston versus Guadalajara matchup. In the main event returning fighter Oscar Perez steps into the ring with Christian Medina for 8 rounds of boxing.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 419 - Red Owl BoxFest XIII part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl BoxFest XIII part 2 from The Owl's Nest in Houston. Up first, Troy Nash with two wins under his belt steps into the ring with David De Leon making his pro debut. In the main event, Marquis Taylor with a reach advantage takes on the taller Ivan Pandzic.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 416 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 39 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 39 part 1 from London. Watch as two veteran bare knuckle fighters Liam Wilson and Jonny Lawson step into the ring. Also on the card Ash Williams versus Joe Fitzpatrick in a British Titile Eliminator bout and Reece Murray versus Adam Grogan in a Bantamweight Title clash plus Ryan Barrett and Richard Samuels throwdown for the British Supermiddleweight crown.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 417 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 39 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 39 part 2 from London.First up in female bout Sweden's Mathilda Wilson faces Romania's Maria Nitescu for a rematch in a Title clash. Next up Carl Hobley and Dan Podmore step into the ring with a World Cruiserweight Title on the line. In the main event Scott McHugh and Aaron McCallum vye for the World Bantamweight Title belt.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 471 - Shamrock FC 370 part 1

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 418 - Country Box 29
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Jimmy Adams Promotions, Country Box "Where Music Meets Boxing" from Nashville at the famous Troubadour venue. In this episode of Country Box 29, Raquan Ashby faces Ryan Diaz and Oliver Mcall is back at age 59, with 39 KO's the former WBC heavyweight champion (knocking out Lennox Lewis) takes on Gary Cobia. In the main event, the more experienced Vaughn Alexander tests the undefeated Maidel Sando. Plus singer Krista Dudley plays an original song.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 420 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1 from Oradea, Romania. Starting in the heavyweight division, Remus Bortea is matched up against Vasile Corcodel whose three wins are all by KO. In a Superfight middleweight division bout, Darius Argyo takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga in what's expected to be a fast paced bout. Also in this episode is Brazil versus Romania with two very experienced fighters, Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Claudio "The Prince" Badoi in an open weight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 421 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2 from Oradea, Romania. In the Super Middleweight division Steven Mendes from France takes on Romania's more experienced Andrei Ostrovanu with 42 wins (24 by KO). In an ISKA Cruiserweight World Title match, Vasileios Karagkiozis and Sebastian Lutanic vie for the belt in a Greece versus Romania bout. Also, in an open weight division Tolea Ciumac and Bogdan Nastase face off in a David versus Goliath match

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 422 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3 from Oradea, Romania. Up first in an ISKA Super Middleweight World Title match, Vinicius Bereta of Brazil takes on Adrian Maxim of Romania with the belt on the line. In the Colossal Division with a total of 723 pounds in the ring, Cristian Anheliuc and Sandu Lungu face off. The ISKA Super Middleweight Wordl title is on the line when Camaroon's Brice Kombou takes on Romania's Andrei Leustean.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 459 - Real Fight Promotion 100
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Real Fight Promotion 100 from Ukraine. In this special centenial event RFP brings its viewers an exciting night of fights. First up Stanislav Bogush and Nazar Pryshliak faceoff in the flyweight division followed by Timofiy Mytkalyk versus Ruslan Danyliuk. Also Vyacheslav Vaseichuk and Andriy Dzioba square off. In the Grand Prix finals, the two remaing fighters Roman Bandrivchak and Stanislov Bogush vye for the championship.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 481 - Dream Boxing 14 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dream Boxing 14 part 1 from Riga, Latvia. First up Miks Berzins takes on Aleksandrs Sidorans for a heavyweight bout. The next matchup is betweeen Mika Bigvava from Georgia and Bohdan Sobol from Latvia with 18 wins and only one loss. In the ffinal match, Aleksis Volkovics, making his pro-debut, and Igor Trosins, both Latvian, take to the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 255 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 1. In a battle between Lithuanian fighters, Zygimantas Kidikas making his pro debut goes up against his 2-0 opponent Ovidijus Pocius. Watch as Aleh Moshin (Belarus) faces Samuelis Sorochovas (Lithuania), Osvaladas Fedorovic takes on the less experienced Aurimas Krukauskas in a battle between Lithuanian fighters and Vladislav Shatunskui (Poland) battles against Gustas Dimsa (Lithuania). In addition Polish fighter Hubert Dylewski takes on Lithuanian Jan Naus in a very evenly matched fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 256 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 2. In this episode, watch as Ukrainian Volodymyr Hynzhu takes on Lithuanian Raimondas Avlasevicius, Finn Larsen (Ireland) goes up against the more experienced Nauris Lukosiunas (Lithuania) and Oleskil Mykhailo 9-0 (Ukraine) faces Henrikas Viksraitis 43-7(Lithuania). In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 257 - Shamrock FC 334
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship out of the Ameristar Casino in St. Charles, MO. In this event Austin Miller faces Arvin Mills in the cage, Arnez Ferguson takes on Pat Vega in a kickboxing bout and in a female match, Livvy Pecher takes on Lora Campbell. Also Jason Gavril faces Isaac Dancy and Nico Alcaraz takes on Todd Madden in the middleweight division. In the Co-Main event Devin Anderson takes on Aushton Elleby Midkiff and in the main event Jeremiah Curtright with a 3 fight win streak takes on Zack Davis with a 4 fight win streak.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 258 - UFA Presents the Fighter's Only World MMA Awards XIII
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the 13th annual Fighter's Only 2021 World MMA Awards from Worre Studios in Las Vegas, hosted by Chael Sonnen. Presentations by Dave Farra, Jessy Jess, Doggface208, Emily Whitmire, Cassie Scherbo, Jay Hieron, Dan Henderson, Kayla Harrison, Mackenzie Dern, and more.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 259 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 1. Young Estonian fighters Stanislav Teniugin and Siim Viljus battle under KOK Kickboxing rules. Aleh Moshin from Belarus takes on Karl Margus Haud out of Estonia and Edvinas Bubelis (Lithuania) faces Sergei Strinza (Estonia). Also, powerhouse Volodymyr Hynzju from Ukraine takes on Aleksey Larin from Estonia.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 260 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 2. Watch as the first ever KOK women's bantamweight world championship title is on the line. In some intense all-female matchups each fighter is vying to move on to the finals for a chance at the title. In the semi-finals Estonians Sigrid Kapanen and Astrid Johanna Grents fight to move on and Italian Ludovica Ciarpaglini faces Polish Ilona Woijda to see who will move on to the Grand Prix final match and have a chance at the title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 261 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 3. Watch as Canadian Mohammed Shushan faces Jevgeni "Zora XXL" Ravlusevits of Estonia and Dzmitry Varats (Belarus) takes on Ott Remmer (Estonia).

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 262 - Shamrock FC 335
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock 335 from Ameristar Casino St Charles. Watch as Pat Gordon takes on Adam Stone, Stanton Ketcherside faces Jerry Ing, Matt Tinker battles it out against James Yarbrough, Kevin Mueller faces Trevon Crawford and Tavae Lewis faces Josh Weston In the co-main event in a kickboxing bout, Ian Zarvos faces Cody Naucke and in the main event Josh Augustin returns to the cage after a long layoff to take on blackbelt Thomas Thatcher.

In the main event Wellington Predador faces Thiago Manchinha in an exciting matchup.

Aleh Moshin from Belarus takes on Karl Margus Haud out of Estonia and Edvinas Bubelis (Lithuania) faces Sergei Strinza (Estonia). Also, powerhouse Volodymyr Hynzju from Ukraine takes on Aleksey Larin from Estonia.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 260 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 2. Watch as the first ever KOK women's bantamweight world championship title is on the line. In some intense all-female matchups each fighter is vying to move on to the finals for a chance at the title. In the semi-finals Estonians Sigrid Kapanen and Astrid Johanna Grents fight to move on and Italian Ludovica Ciarpaglini faces Polish Ilona Woijda to see who will move on to the Grand Prix final match and have a chance at the title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 261 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 3. Watch as Canadian Mohammed Shushan faces Jevgeni "Zora XXL" Ravlusevits of Estonia and Dzmitry Varats (Belarus) takes on Ott Remmer (Estonia).

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 262 - Shamrock FC 335
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock 335 from Ameristar Casino St Charles. Watch as Pat Gordon takes on Adam Stone, Stanton Ketcherside faces Jerry Ing, Matt Tinker battles it out against James Yarbrough, Kevin Mueller faces Trevon Crawford and Tavae Lewis faces Josh Weston In the co-main event in a kickboxing bout, Ian Zarvos faces Cody Naucke and in the main event Josh Augustin returns to the cage after a long layoff to take on blackbelt Thomas Thatcher.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 263 - SFT 30 - Predador vs Manchinha
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT 30 from Brazil. Denis Araujo with 6 KO's meets Jose Reborn Alexandre in the cage for a fierce MMA bout. In a compelling matchup, Paulo Pizzo takes on the much younger Fernando "ben 10" Lourenco and in the lightweight division #1 ranked Felipe Buakaw takes on #2 Marcio Velaminho. In the main event Wellington Predador faces Thiago Manchinha in an exciting matchup.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 255 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 1. In a battle between Lithuanian fighters, Zygimantas Kidikas making his pro debut goes up against his 2-0 opponent Ovidijus Pocius. Watch as Aleh Moshin (Belarus) faces Samuelis Sorochovas (Lithuania), Osvaladas Fedorovic takes on the less experienced Aurimas Krukauskas in a battle between Lithuanian fighters and Vladislav Shatunskui (Poland) battles against Gustas Dimsa (Lithuania). In addition Polish fighter Hubert Dylewski takes on Lithuanian Jan Naus in a very evenly matched fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 256 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 2. In this episode, watch as Ukrainian Volodymyr Hynzhu takes on Lithuanian Raimondas Avlasevicius, Finn Larsen (Ireland) goes up against the more experienced Nauris Lukosiunas (Lithuania) and Oleskil Mykhailo 9-0 (Ukraine) faces Henrikas Viksraitis 43-7(Lithuania). In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 257 - Shamrock FC 334
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship out of the Ameristar Casino in St. Charles, MO. In this event Austin Miller faces Arvin Mills in the cage, Arnez Ferguson takes on Pat Vega in a kickboxing bout and in a female match, Livvy Pecher takes on Lora Campbell. Also Jason Gavril faces Isaac Dancy and Nico Alcaraz takes on Todd Madden in the middleweight division. In the Co-Main event Devin Anderson takes on Aushton Elleby Midkiff and in the main event Jeremiah Curtright with a 3 fight win streak takes on Zack Davis with a 4 fight win streak.

programme.title: S1E1 Tour
programme.desc: Pursuing the Tour de France, one of the most physically demanding sporting events in the world, covers over 3,535 kilometers in just three weeks. Every young cyclist dreams of competing in this prestigious race, but only nine riders from each team make the cut. Young cyclist Adam Yates is giving everything he has to prove he belongs on cycling’s biggest stage. 2016 Tour de France winner Chris Froome reflects on the long and grueling journey to victory, while former professional cyclists and Tour de France veterans Jens Voigt, Christian Vande Velde, and Haimar Zubeldia reveal what it truly takes to compete at the highest level.

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Watch as he pushes his limits on some of the most dangerous downhill courses in the world, from steep, rocky descents to twisting forest trails, attacking every challenge with unmatched skill and determination. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

programme.title: S1E1 Moto
programme.desc: Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa on the adventure of a lifetime as they explore the vibrant cities and stunning beaches of Morocco. Plus, enjoy exclusive bonus footage featuring the very best of GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E2 Moto
programme.desc: The journey continues as we follow two brothers on their 2,300-kilometer adventure across Morocco. Two brothers. Two motorcycles. Ride along with GoPro Family members Carlos and Alex Costa as they experience vibrant cities, breathtaking beaches, and the adventure of a lifetime. Plus, enjoy bonus footage of Jeremy Seewer. With 50 podiums, 11 victories, 17 race wins, and five FIM Motocross World Championship silver medals, his record is remarkable — yet his story goes far beyond the numbers.

Meet Teigan Nash, co-founder of Girls Who Glow, inspiring young women everywhere. Plus, experience even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

Plus, enjoy even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E1 Draft Story
programme.desc: In Part 1, we uncover the story of Tyvis Powell and the people who shaped him into the man and football player he is today. His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S2E1 Moto
programme.desc: Celebrate the women of GoPro, including British rally driver Catie Munnings, who rose to fame after winning the FIA European Rally Championship Ladies Trophy at just 18. Watch snowboarder Alina Hight who made history as the first to land a double backside alley-oop rodeo in a halfpipe competition. Meet Teigan Nash, co-founder of Girls Who Glow, inspiring young women everywhere. Plus, experience even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S3E1 Moto
programme.desc: GoPro Athlete and Formula 1 star Daniel Ricciardo teams up with Race Service Co-Founder James Kirkham for an unforgettable ride through Los Angeles. With eight Grand Prix victories and 32 podiums to his name, the Honey Badger spends his day off behind the wheel of supercars like the Ford GT, racing past Beverly Hills, the Sunset Strip, and into the winding roads of Benedict Canyon. Plus, enjoy even more of the very best from GoPro Motorsports.

programme.title: S1E1 Driven
programme.desc:
GoPro Motorsports Original Series DRIVEN takes you deep inside the world of Supercross and Motocross champion James Stewart. Ride alongside the man known as the fastest on two wheels as he shares the highs, lows, and relentless drive that shaped his legendary career.
GoPro Original Series DRIVEN also follows X Games star and snowmobile icon Chris Burandt. Join him on a thrilling journey to discover what fuels his passion and dedication to the lifestyle he has loved since childhood. This is raw, high-octane storytelling you can’t miss.

programme.title: S1E2 Driven
programme.desc: In this episode of GoPro Original Series DRIVEN, we continue our in-depth look at X Games star and snowmobile legend Chris Burandt. Join him on an adrenaline-fueled journey to uncover what drives his passion and dedication to the lifestyle he has loved since childhood. The second part goes inside the life of three-time NASCAR Cup Series Champion and Daytona 500 winner Joey Logano. Watch as he pushes the limits on the track and discovers how he uses his racing platform to make a difference in the lives of others.

programme.title: S1E3 Driven
programme.desc: Three-time NASCAR Cup Series Champion and Daytona 500 winner Joey Logano continues to push the limits on the track while finding new ways to use his racing platform to make a positive impact on others. In this episode of GoPro Motorsports Original Series DRIVEN, step into the world of DC Shoes co-founder, rally car driver, and marketing mastermind Ken Block. Strap in for an electrifying journey through the moments and passions that have fueled his remarkable career.

Adventure, speed, and skill collide in every ride.

programme.title: S1E3 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you on the world’s most thrilling rides. Watch GoPro athletes Sam Pilgrim, urban downhill master, and Nicholi Rogatkin, freestyle powerhouse, tackle the Downhill Challenge Medellín, the longest urban downhill race, with #HyperSmooth. Then join Gee, Rachel, and Dan Atherton, enduro and downhill champions, as they ride together through heart-pounding terrain. Speed, skill, and adrenaline collide in every unforgettable moment.

programme.title: S2E1 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike brings you the world’s most thrilling rides. Watch Sam Reynolds, street shredder, Clemens Kaudela, slopestyle champion, Theo Erlangsen, trail innovator, and Vincent Tupin, downhill powerhouse, in an exhilarating GoPro Course Preview in South Africa. Then head to Zion, Utah for Red Bull Rampage with Jaxson Riddle, big-air phenom, Reed Boggs, freeride master, Thomas Genon, slopestyle superstar, and Tom Van Steenbergen, trail blazing pro, as they push the limits of skill and courage on some of the planet’s most extreme terrain.

programme.title: S2E2 Bike
programme.desc: GoPro Bike takes you on epic rides around the world. Watch Olympic gold medalist Conor Fields, BMX champion, compete at the highest level, then join GoPro athletes Sam Pilgrim, urban downhill master, Geoff Gulevich, trail expert, and Sam Reynolds, street shredder, as they explore the stunning landscapes and dramatic terrain of Cappadocia, Turkey. Adventure, speed, and skill collide in every breathtaking moment.

Then experience some of the best riders from around the globe as they conquer massive mountains, perform jaw-dropping tricks, and push the limits of skill and adrenaline in breathtaking terrain.

programme.title: S1E1 Two Roads
programme.desc:
“Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today.
This episode features Olympic bronze medalist Kristian Ipsen, American rugby union star Carlin Isles — celebrated as “The Fastest Man in Rugby” — and his remarkable rise from track and field and American football to becoming a two-time Olympian in rugby sevens. You’ll also meet Allison Stokke, a record-breaking high school pole vaulter who went on to compete at UC Berkeley, and Miles Chamley-Watson, a British-American fencing champion whose career includes 13 team Pan American titles, a 2019 team world championship, a 2013 individual world championship, three Olympic appearances, and a 2016 team Olympic bronze medal.

programme.title: S1E2 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Trenten Merrill, an American Paralympic long jumper who claimed bronze at the 2020 Summer Paralympics. Also featured is Casey Patterson, a powerhouse in professional beach volleyball with numerous AVP tournament wins, a gold medal on the FIVB World Tour, and an appearance at the 2016 Rio Olympics alongside Jake Gibb. Tennis legends Bob and Mike Bryan, the most successful doubles team in history, take the spotlight with 16 Grand Slam titles, 119 ATP Tour doubles victories, 438 weeks as the world’s No. 1 team, and Olympic gold in 2012. Rounding out the episode is acclaimed gymnastics coach Liang Chow, celebrated for guiding Gabby Douglas to the 2012 Olympic all-around gold and coaching Shawn Johnson to multiple medals at the 2008 Olympics.

programme.title: S1E3 Two Roads
programme.desc: “Two Roads” is an original GoPro series that follows nine athletes and one coach who have committed themselves to the relentless pursuit of greatness. Each episode dives deep into an athlete’s unique journey, revealing the life-changing moments that shaped the path they walk today. This episode features Paul Rabil, legendary professional lacrosse player and co-founder of the Premier Lacrosse League, celebrated as one of the greatest in the sport’s history. Also featured is Britney Henry, a standout track and field athlete from the University of Oregon who captured the Pac-10 Conference title in the hammer throw. Rounding out the episode is Meagan Martin, trailblazing competitor as the first female rookie to complete the American Ninja Warrior course and the first-ever Women’s Champion of the series.

programme.title: S1E1 Adventure Series
programme.desc: Join “The Lion Whisperer” Kevin Richardson and a fearless team of conservationists on an epic mission to protect the planet’s most majestic and endangered predators. From rescuing lions at the Kevin Richardson Wildlife Sanctuary in South Africa to safeguarding orangutans and Cape Griffons in the wilds of Indonesia, witness heart-pounding rescues, fierce battles against exploitation, and inspiring stories of survival. This is conservation at its most daring—unmissable, unforgettable, and truly wild.

programme.title: S2E1 Adventure Series
programme.desc: From polar bears to roaring lions—this is GoPro Adventures at its wildest. Dive into jaw-dropping encounters with lions, whales, turtles, giraffes, and watch “The Lion Whisperer” Kevin Richardson at his South African sanctuary, where rescued predators find a second chance. It’s the ultimate fusion of wildlife wonder and high-octane thrills—you won’t be able to look away.

programme.title: S2E2 Adventure Series
programme.desc: Motorbikes, speed, and pure adrenaline—this is the ultimate GoPro adventure. Ride with Mexican enduro master Didier Goirand, push limits alongside British racing icon Maria Costello, the only female motorcycle racer ever to be awarded an MBE, and feel the thrill with American motorsports legend and DC Shoes founder Ken Block. High-octane action, world-class talent, and breathtaking moments—you won’t want to miss a second.

programme.title: S1E1 Skate
programme.desc: This episode features the inspiring story of founders Miguel and Isabel. Driven by the belief that kids should be free to just be kids, #GoProForACause partner SanSkate is making a real difference in their community. Their mission is to provide a safe space for children who enter the workforce at a young age, giving them a chance to set aside their struggles and enjoy skateboarding. The episode also showcases the very best of GoPro skateboarding, featuring incredible talent from Andrew Brophy, Sewa Kroetkov, Madars Apse, and more.

programme.title: S1E2 Skate
programme.desc: Watch the inspiring story of Mike Rogers, an all-around skateboarding star from Cocoa Beach, FL. A regular competitor at top events around the world, including the Vans Pro-Tec Pool Party, Vans Bowl-A-Rama at Bondi Beach, and the Clash at Clairemont, Mike showcases his skill, style, and dedication to the sport. The episode also features Leticia Bufoni and Cata Diaz as she shares her perspective on women in skateboarding and explains why MACBA in Barcelona has become a world-renowned destination for skaters, with its iconic plaza, unique architecture, and perfectly smooth concrete.

programme.title: S1E3 Skate
programme.desc: Experience the very best of GoPro skateboarding at MACBA, Barcelona, celebrated worldwide as the ultimate Spanish skateboarding mecca. In 2018, we teamed up with Macba Life to follow the local skating community and capture the most jaw-dropping tricks this iconic plaza has to offer. Don’t miss this unforgettable collaboration with #MacbaLife.

programme.title: S1E1 Lucha
programme.desc: Ian Hodgkinson, known as Vampiro in the world of wrestling, was a famed wrestler in the late 80’s and 90’s. Today, he shifted his career to being behind the scenes as a Story Producer for AAA, the top wrestling company in Lucha Libre. Hodgkinson intimately peels back the curtain on the mysteries of this show, how it’s produced, and what life is like on and off the stage. We dive deep in to the lives of two wrestlers and follow their stories as they prep for their next fight: El Hijo Del Fantasma, an up and coming star who seemingly has it all, as well as Faby Apache, a veteran female wrestler struggling to stay relevant as she raises her son.

programme.title: S1E1 The Jackson Goldstone Story
programme.desc: Beyond Limits: The Jackson Goldstone Story is an electrifying YouTube series that follows mountain biking sensation Jackson Goldstone through his 2023 UCI Downhill World Championship season. Go behind the scenes to see the intense training sessions, precise bike tuning, and mental preparation that fuel his success. Experience the rush of high-stakes racing with heart-pounding runs, fierce rivalries, and moments that will keep you holding your breath. More than just the action, Beyond Limits reveals Jackson’s personal journey, the sacrifices he makes for his passion, and the powerful support network that drives him forward. This is the ultimate inside look at a world-class athlete chasing glory on two wheels.

His road to the NFL was anything but easy, and it nearly never happened without the guidance of his mentor, Sean Williams. A Draft Story is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he makes the leap to professional football. Though he was not invited to Chicago for the 2016 NFL Draft, his journey is unforgettable. Witness the tension, hope, and emotion as Tyvis waits for the call that will change his life and etch the Powell name into NFL history. This is his Draft Story.

programme.title: S1 E2 Draft Story
programme.desc: A Draft Story” Part 2 is a GoPro Original Production that follows Ohio State safety Tyvis Powell as he takes the leap into professional football. Facing unexpected challenges, honoring a promise to local kids, and navigating a situation he never imagined, Tyvis proves that the journey to the NFL is full of twists, heart, and determination.

programme.title: GKA Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025- 26min-HL
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline. From 25 to 30 October, the world’s top kiteboarders will take to Fahid Island’s pristine waters in a six-day spectacle of high-flying action, part of the Fahid Island Watersports Festival – a nine-day celebration that will also feature the season finale of the GWA Wingfoil World Tour and the championship deciders of the SFT Surf Foil World Tour. In Hydrofoil Big Air, the battle for the world title is a close-run thing. New Zealand’s Hugo Wigglesworth, 18, heads the rankings after he burst on to the scene and dominated the opening stop of the season in Sylt, Germany, in August. But Finn Flügel, of Germany, who sits second overall, vowed that he would be back in Abu Dhabi, gunning for the title in what are likely to be similar, lighter breezes of the Gulf.

Xavier is his 15 year old autistic nephew, and as he loves cycling as much as him, Adrien wanted to help the association “Des Rêves pour Xavier” (Dreams for Xavier) to finance an electric tandem. Adrien’s other goal was to raise autism awareness among as many people as possible.

programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
